---
title: "Dashboard title"
# phw-palette: accessible   # colour-blind safe colours in every chart and table
format: phw-dashboard
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(phwstyle)
use_phw_ggplot()
set.seed(2)
d <- tidyr::expand_grid(group = paste("Group", 1:4), period = 1:13) |>
  mutate(value = round(runif(n(), 10, 60) + period * 3))
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "First measure"
list(value = 84, color = "primary")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Second measure"
list(value = 19, color = "info")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Third measure"
list(value = "12.4", color = "light")
```

## Row {height=80%}

```{r}
#| title: Value by group
plotly_ok <- requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)
p <- ggplot(d, aes(period, value, colour = group)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_phw_d(key = "group") + labs(x = "Period", y = "Value")
if (plotly_ok) phw_plotly(p, source = "Example data") else p
```

```{r}
#| title: Latest period
d |>
  filter(period == max(period)) |>
  select(Group = group, Value = value) |>
  phw_reactable(group_col = Group, key = "group")
```
